about: Synthetic demo vault: an invented German household, produced with Banking4. Every value is made up. See README.md. Do not edit.

not_reproducible.note: These values belong to this one file: every new container gets a new salt, content key and file GUID and is stamped with the current time. Everything else in this manifest depends on the content only.

notation.source: Everything below vault is the expected result of reading the finished vault. The numbers say what the vault reads as, not what was written.
notation.entries: Every entry of the container in Banking4's listing order, directories before their content. size is the content length in bytes, sha256 the digest of the decrypted content. class: collection (a record file of the format description), directory (an Acct<oid> or Stock<oid> directory), bank_access (the nine entries that hold bank access data or secrets, among them the outbox, the settings and the online traces: never read, not even listed into), legacy_placeholder (Accts: ignored because AcctsNew exists; Banking4 decodes its one record of account kind 0 and then drops it), unknown (a name the format description does not have: skipped with a warning, b4_warns). Entries below a directory that is not read are not read either. The content of every file with b4_reads false, except Accts, is the ASCII text of decoy_marker written marker_repeats times back to back and nothing else (no line breaks, no terminator), so that text anywhere in b4's output proves a defect. These files are not valid records, on purpose.
notation.totals: Records per record type over all collection files that b4 reads (Accts left out).
notation.accounts: One object per record of AcctsNew, in file order. statement_balance is the stored balance as it reads. booking_records counts all records of Acct<oid>/Stmt. Each record falls into exactly one of three groups: masters (split 0x01 or 0x10, whatever their status: they stand for their parts and are never counted), booked (booking_status 0, not a master) and pending (booking_status 1 or 2, not a master). all_records is the three together, that is the sum a query gets that ignores status and role. credit_sum and debit_sum are sums of the unsigned amounts by effective direction, net is credit_sum minus debit_sum; all are exact decimals. first_booking_date and last_booking_date range over every record that has a booking date. balance_check: for kinds that have statements (bank, cash, credit card, PayPal, crypto) every demo account starts at 0.00 and its statement_balance equals booked.net. The securities account has no statements and its balance reads as 0.
notation.categories: The catalogue in file order, then one row with category null for records without one. booking_records counts the booking records of all accounts whose category is that exact name; booked takes only records that are booked and not a master, the same rule as for accounts.
notation.reader_changes: Every stored field that reads as another value than was written. These are the rules of the format description a reader has to follow to arrive at the manifest's values.
notation.samples: Selected records in full. fields has every field of the record as it is held in memory after reading, under this project's field names (docs/format 03 to 05, the same names and value forms as the JSON files in tests/fixtures/records): decimals are strings that keep their scale; calendar dates are "YYYY-MM-DD", timestamps "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.fffffff", times "HH:MM:SS", each null when not set; enumerations and bit sets are numbers; multi-line texts are arrays of lines; a security identifier is an object with the text, its kind and the ISIN derived from it; a retention period is an object with unit and count. index is the position of the record in its file. For records of the payment family, account_kind and account_currency name the account the values hold for, and derived holds values Banking4 computes from the fields (effective direction, signed value, displayed currency).

accts_placeholder.note: The one record of Accts. banking4_default_account: a new account of kind none with the values Banking4 gives it, as Banking4 creates it when it migrates a vault, then given a fixed id, number and update stamp. Entries of reader_changes with path Accts are differences between that record as it reads and the placeholder as docs/format/03 describes it.

banking4_load.how: The expected result of loading each file by Banking4's rules (dropping, changing, adding and sorting records). The lists that hold bank access data, traces and the outbox are not part of it, and neither is anything Banking4 does to a vault besides loading these files. loads_reported_as_failed names the files whose load fails: Banking4 reads ModelSettings on its own account, and in this vault that entry is not a settings file. Per file: the number of records in the file, the number of records in the loaded list, and every difference between a loaded record and what reading that record on its own gives. order_kept is left out where the order depends on the day.
